name: The Unsteady Survivor
visual_description: A bipedal beast of sinew and confusion. Its movement is awkward, too many limbs, eyes sunken. It lingers where others perished.
meaning: Survival without triumph. Mutation by mourning.
existential_reflection: This one is me. Not victorious. Not slain. Simply *left behind.* Mizontresh did not resurrect me—it observed me surviving myself. An atrocity still walking.
